SELECT 
    (SUM((ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity) - (ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity * ol.DiscountPct / 100)) - 
     SUM(p.UnitCost * ol.Quantity)) * 100.0 / 
    SUM((ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity) - (ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity * ol.DiscountPct / 100)) AS GrossMarginPercentage
FROM 
    sales.OrderLines ol
JOIN 
    sales.Orders o ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN 
    catalog.Products p ON ol.ProductId = p.ProductId
WHERE 
    YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM((ol.UnitPrice - p.UnitCost) * ol.Quantity) AS decimal(14, 2)) * 100.0 / 
  SUM(ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM sales.OrderLines AS ol
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId
WHERE ol.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND ol.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM((ol.UnitPrice - p.UnitCost) * ol.Quantity) AS decimal(14, 2)) * 100.0 / 
  SUM(ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM sales.OrderLines AS ol
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT CAST(100.0 * (SUM(l.LineTotal) - SUM(l.Quantity * p.UnitCost)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.LineTotal), 0) AS decimal(5, 2)) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
    w.Name AS WarehouseName,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM 
    inventory.Warehouses w
JOIN 
    sales.Orders o ON w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId
GROUP BY 
    w.Name

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.Name AS Warehouse, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(5, 2)) * 100.0 / 
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status IN ('Shipped', 'Delivered', 'Returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ReturnRate
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN inventory.Warehouses AS w ON w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.Name
